scene: The clock tower chimes, illuminating three distinct transit routes below the roof.
picture: A flat side view along the rooftop depot platform. On the far left sits a waiting yellow night tram. To the left stands the dark-haired boy with camera and glasses. In the centre sits a ticket console, while to the right a rowing boat bobs at a canal sluice, beside an open freight lift.
shown: a glowing yellow night tram parked on raised rails at the far left
a wooden rowing boat moored beside a canal lock on the right
a heavy iron freight lift with an open gate at the far right
